text:
For a letter full of official wording, take a photo with the account numbers covered, add it in ChatGPT with the plus button, and ask:

What is this letter asking me to do, by what date, and what happens if I do nothing? Explain it in plain English.

Call the number printed on the letter if anything is unclear. Day 3 of my $9 AI Made Simple workbook practices this, linked in my profile.
